title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF, with UNDP and UN Women, advanced SDG-aligned strategies in eight local communities and three cantons. By integrating the "Leave No One Behind" principle into planning, 3,014 beneficiaries (1,854 children/youth) directly benefited, alongside 43,283 indirectly, leveraging 25% local funds and ensuring sustainable, inclusive development for children and families.;
